chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdullah, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'If it was befitting for anyone that he should be stoned twice, it would be the sodomist (Luti) to be stoned.'
ai.seo_question: Who deserves to be stoned twice according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) declares that if anyone deserved to be stoned twice due to the severity of their sin, the sodomist (Luti) would be the one. This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the high status of sodomy among major sins (Kabirah) in Shia jurisprudence, often cited to justify the double penalty or its severity relative to other hudud crimes. It reflects the scholarly view that while the Quranic punishment is stoning, the specific mention of 'twice' emphasizes the unique gravity of the act as a violation of natural order.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If it was befitting for anyone that he should be stoned twice, it would be sodomist to be stoned’.
